kind: local engineering review, separate from blocked MCP scan

categories.read-code: Source/test text reviewed by the recorded author; same-byte hashes or explicitly read current diffs preserve the review chain. No claim that every historical workflow was executed.
categories.validated-data: Configuration, serialized data, legal notice or asset metadata. These are not claimed as application logic read line by line; JSON syntax is additionally checked here.

limits: Manual source review is separate from the blocked official MCP scan and is not proof of absence of vulnerabilities.
Historical retained features were reviewed as code; reachability and execution validation are described in their original ledgers.
External SDK dependencies and personal profiles/credentials are outside the 390-file denominator.
Additional PNG assets were checked as metadata only; this report does not claim pixel inspection.
Current hashes are computed independently from the original ledger hashes; previous hashes are retained and are not silently rewritten.
hashBasis: sha256 identifies reviewed Windows checkout bytes; sourceBlobSha256 identifies the committed bytes. Outside app, Git may normalize line endings; every difference is checked to be CRLF/LF only.
